title: Brood War Bench
summary: A benchmarking framework and report for StarCraft: Brood War AI bots, providing performance metrics and comparison tools for testing game-playing agents against the classic RTS game.
problem_solved: Provides standardized benchmarking methodology and metrics for evaluating StarCraft Brood War AI bot performance and capabilities.
why_valuable: Enables researchers and developers to objectively measure and compare AI bot performance in one of the most challenging classic RTS environments, facilitating better bot development and competition.
